title: OpenAI releases GPT-5 with enhanced reasoning
description: OpenAI today announced GPT-5, featuring significantly improved reasoning capabilities and a 128k context window. The model achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.

title: Hugging Face launches SmolLM2 open-source family
description: Hugging Face releases SmolLM2, a family of small but capable language models optimized for on-device inference. Models range from 135M to 1.7B parameters.

title: New RAG technique achieves 95% accuracy on long-document QA
description: Researchers propose HyperRAG, a hierarchical retrieval-augmented generation framework that handles documents up to 500 pages with minimal hallucination.

title: LangGraph adds multi-agent coordination primitives
description: LangGraph v0.2 ships with supervisor and worker agent patterns, making it easier to build hierarchical multi-agent pipelines with state persistence.

title: NVIDIA announces H200 SXM availability in major cloud providers
description: NVIDIA H200 SXM GPUs are now available on AWS, Azure, and GCP, offering 141GB HBM3e memory and 4.8 TB/s memory bandwidth.
